history.administration_response: The broad governance structure for occupational safety and health has been piloted by the Occupational Safety and Health Committee at Headquarters in 2021–2022 and the terms of reference and related structures have been tested. It will be formalized with the management committee by the target date of 30 June 2022. The Administration requests that the Board consider the recommendation implemented and close it.
history.board_assessment: Given that the broad governance structure was piloted by the Occupational Safety and Health Committee, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
